title: Econometric vs. Causal structure learning for time-series data: Implications for policy interventions using COVID-19 data
abstract: arXiv:2603.00041v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This study compares regression-based and causal structure-learning approaches to recovering temporal dependencies in UK COVID-19 data and assesses their suitability for policy analysis. We evaluate four econometric methods and eleven structure-learning algorithms using a common lag-expanded dataset that permits edges only from past to current variables. The dataset comprises 866 daily observations and 45 variables, represented by 55 numeric series after categorical encoding. Maximum lags of 1, 7, 14, 17 and 21 days are examined; all four econometric methods and ten structure-learning algorithms successfully return structures at every lag specification.   We compare graph structure, complexity, fit and temporal-edge stability across lag specifications. The resulting graphs vary substantially in density, complexity, fit and stability. translated_title: 计量经济学方法与因果结构学习在时间序列数据上的对比：基于COVID-19数据对政策干预的启示
translated_abstract: 本研究比较了基于回归的计量经济学方法与因果结构学习方法在恢复英国COVID-19数据中时间依赖性方面的表现，并评估了它们在政策分析中的适用性。我们使用一个共同的滞后扩展数据集评估了四种计量经济学方法和十一种结构学习算法，该数据集仅允许从过去变量指向当前变量的边。数据集包含866个日观测值和45个变量，经过类别编码后由55个数值序列表示。研究考察了1、7、14、17和21天的最大滞后；所有四种计量经济学方法和十种结构学习算法在每个滞后设定下均成功返回了结构。我们比较了不同滞后设定下的图结构、复杂度、拟合度以及时间边的稳定性。所得的图在密度、复杂度、拟合度和稳定性方面差异显著。与知识图谱的一致性有限，而较低的结构汉明距离有时……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 本研究在英国COVID-19时间序列数据上系统对比了四种计量经济学方法与十一种因果结构学习算法，发现不同方法学习到的时序依赖图在密度、复杂度、拟合度和稳定性上差异显著且与先验知识图谱一致性有限，提示将此类方法用于政策干预分析时需谨慎。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares four econometric methods and eleven causal structure-learning algorithms on UK COVID-19 time-series data, showing that the learned temporal dependency graphs differ substantially in density, complexity, fit and stability with limited agreement to prior knowledge, cautioning against uncritical use of these methods for policy intervention analysis.
